name: FitRush XR
summary:
Step into a new era of fitness with FitRush XR, an immersive VR workout experience that turns exercise into an exciting challenge.

Enter futuristic fitness arenas where every movement counts. Punch targets, dodge obstacles, squat, move side to side, and react quickly through full-body workouts designed to improve strength, stamina, coordination, and reflexes.

FitRush XR combines VR gaming with real physical movement, helping you stay active in a more engaging way.

Key Features:

VR Combat Training
Punch
